description: Single source of truth for which provider serves which model call. Read by apps/web/lib/ai/routing.ts at runtime and by scripts/ai-routing-check.mjs, which flags drift between this file and the live Gateway report, Vercel env flags and the Workers AI relay. Change routing here, never in prose.

gateway.label: Vercel AI Gateway
gateway.funding: prepaid-credit (Vercel team jovie, shared by every key and by Summer's OIDC)

failover.credit: Either provider answering with insufficient funds, budget exceeded, 402 or an out-of-allocation message is replayed once on the other provider (apps/web/lib/ai/credit-failover.ts); the dead provider is skipped for 60 seconds.

callers.label: Jovie web non-chat calls (classifiers, extractors, insights, titles, crons)
Golden path recorded visual review (CI vision screening)
Buyer-eval strong tier (vision conversion forecaster over recorded walks)
callers.note: Through the Workers AI relay (WORKERS_AI_TOKEN). Flash is the vision model: @cf/zai-org/glm-5.3 on Workers AI drops image parts (measured 2026-10-31, JOV-10091). Replaced the claude -p subscription route.

callers.label: Hermes agent (outside this repo; model glm-5.2 is off the web allowlist)
callers.note: Follow-up: Workers AI hosts @cf/zai-org/glm-5.2 at the same list price; move Hermes to workers-first.

callers.label: Summer agent turns and fast chat
Summer utility completions (System-1 reference, compact, judgment, web conversation)
Summer strategic planner (strong model, no Workers AI twin)
Jev decision model (triage routing, per-turn critic)
callers.note: Jev is Gateway-only. Cloudflare's Clef is the Workers AI decision model; it is wired for screenshots (clef-screenshot-evaluator) and is the migration target once a critic eval shows parity.
